diagrams.title: DFD Level 0
diagrams.description: High-level Data Flow Diagram for E-Commerce Application

threats.title: T4 - Product Price Manipulation
threats.description: Attacker modifies product pricing information during requests.
threats.mitigation: Server-side validation and integrity checks.

threats.title: T5 - Product Information Exposure
threats.description: Unauthorized access to hidden or restricted product data.
threats.mitigation: Access control and API authorization.

threats.title: T6 - Product Service DoS
threats.description: Massive search requests overload product service.
threats.mitigation: Rate limiting and load balancing.

threats.title: T16 - Password Exposure
threats.description: User passwords or password hashes are exposed due to database compromise or insecure storage mechanisms.
threats.mitigation: Store passwords using strong hashing algorithms such as bcrypt or Argon2, encrypt sensitive data, and restrict database access.

threats.title: T17 - User Record Modification
threats.description: An attacker alters user account information, roles, permissions, or personal details stored in the database.
threats.mitigation: Implement database access controls, input validation, audit logging, and integrity monitoring mechanisms.

threats.title: T18 - Database Locking Attack
threats.description: An attacker causes excessive database locks or resource consumption, preventing legitimate transactions from being processed.
threats.mitigation: Implement connection limits, query optimization, monitoring, rate limiting, and database resource management controls.

threats.title: T19 - Product Catalog Tampering
threats.description: An attacker modifies product catalog information including prices, descriptions, or inventory records.
threats.mitigation: Use access controls, change approval processes, audit logs, and database integrity verification mechanisms.

threats.title: T20 - Product Data Leakage
threats.description: Restricted product information, supplier details, or internal business data is exposed to unauthorized users.
threats.mitigation: Implement authorization checks, encrypt sensitive data, and restrict access based on user roles.

threats.title: T21 - Order Record Modification
threats.description: An attacker alters order records, transaction details, or shipment information stored in the database.
threats.mitigation: Implement database access controls, transaction integrity checks, audit logging, and change monitoring.

threats.title: T22 - Customer Order Leakage
threats.description: Sensitive customer order information is exposed through unauthorized database access or insecure APIs.
threats.mitigation: Encrypt sensitive data, enforce authorization checks, apply least privilege access, and monitor database activities.

threats.title: T23 - Credential Interception
threats.description: User credentials are intercepted during transmission due to insecure communication channels.
threats.mitigation: Use HTTPS/TLS, secure cookies, HSTS, certificate validation, and encrypted communication channels.

threats.title: T24 - Request Manipulation
threats.description: An attacker modifies requests in transit to alter product information, pricing, or transaction details.
threats.mitigation: Implement HTTPS, request validation, message integrity verification, and secure API design.

threats.title: T25 - Order Repudiation
threats.description: A customer denies placing an order after the transaction has been processed. Lack of audit trails and transaction records makes verification difficult.
threats.mitigation: Maintain audit logs, timestamps, transaction records, digital signatures, and non-repudiation controls.

threats.title: T7 - Cart Tampering
threats.description: Attacker modifies quantity or pricing information in cart.
threats.mitigation: Server-side validation and price recalculation.

threats.title: T8 - Cart Action Repudiation
threats.description: User denies adding products to cart.
threats.mitigation: Audit logging and transaction records.

threats.title: T9 - Cart Data Exposure
threats.description: Shopping cart information exposed to other users.
threats.mitigation: Access controls and session isolation.

threats.title: T10 - Order Tampering
threats.description: An attacker modifies order details such as quantity, price, shipping address, or payment information before order submission.
threats.mitigation: Implement server-side validation, digitally sign critical transactions, validate order totals on the server, and use secure APIs with integrity checks.

threats.title: T11 - Order Information Disclosure
threats.description: Unauthorized users gain access to customer order history, shipping details, or payment-related information.
threats.mitigation: Enforce access control checks, encrypt sensitive data, implement secure API authorization, and apply least privilege principles.

threats.title: T12 - Unauthorized Order Access
threats.description: A user accesses, modifies, or cancels orders belonging to another customer by exploiting authorization weaknesses.
threats.mitigation: Implement object-level authorization, role-based access control, ownership validation, and security testing for authorization bypass vulnerabilities.

threats.title: T13 - Admin Account Spoofing
threats.description: An attacker impersonates an administrator using stolen credentials, session hijacking, or credential stuffing attacks.
threats.mitigation: Implement multi-factor authentication, secure session management, strong password policies, and anomaly detection for administrator accounts.

threats.title: T14 - Admin Privilege Escalation
threats.description: A normal user exploits authorization flaws to gain administrative privileges and perform restricted operations.
threats.mitigation: Implement strict RBAC, server-side authorization checks, periodic privilege reviews, and security testing for privilege escalation vulnerabilities.

threats.title: T15 - Unauthorized Product Changes
threats.description: An attacker modifies product information, pricing, inventory, or availability without authorization.
threats.mitigation: Apply strong authorization controls, maintain audit logs, enforce approval workflows, and validate all administrative actions.

threats.title: T1 - Credential Theft
threats.description: Attacker uses stolen credentials to impersonate a legitimate user account.
threats.mitigation: Enable multi-factor authentication, strong password policies, account lockout, and secure session management.

threats.title: T2 - Privilege Escalation
threats.description: Attacker manipulates role information and gains administrator privileges.
threats.mitigation: Implement role-based access control, server-side authorization checks, and privilege reviews.

threats.title: T3 - Authentication DoS
threats.description: Large number of login requests exhaust authentication resources.
threats.mitigation: Large number of login requests exhaust authentication resources.
